description.content: Requirement API
To retrieve all Requirements or Requirements under a specific Module

query.description: Specify the parent Module's ID to retrieve all of its Requirements which are located directly under the parent Module
By default the first page is returned but you can specify any page number to retrieve requirements.

The result is paginated. By the default, the number of requirements in each page is 20.

You can specify your custom number in this parameter.
By default, Requirement external properties are not included in the response. Specify includeExternalProperties=true to include them.

response.name: successful operation
